Best Wings on This Side of the Pacific
Sep 2018 • Solo
I was born in Buffalo, so I feel like the wing life is imprinted on my DNA. Having grown up with wings as my personal staple food, I can say with 100% confidence that this restaurant has the best wings on this side of the Pacific. I go here every time I'm in Saigon, and crave it when I'm not in town.

Namesake food aside, the rest of the food here is really, really good. The burger is one of the best in HCMC, the chicken sandwich (which can even be ordered with the Saigon Kiss sauce, recommended), the Philly cheesesteak with in-house made cheese sauce... seriously, in a week-long visit to Saigon, I go to this place 3 or 4 times.

Great little dive bar with some tasty food
Dec 2017 • Friends
It's a cozy little dive bar, just far enough from Bui Vien Street to avoid the craziness, but still gets in a nice variety of chatty travelers. Lots of regulars at this place, most of whom are friendly and up for a conversation if you wish, some are pretty entertaining characters and most are serious about their drinking sessions. You'd think a small space and loads of booze in the punters might make for some trouble, but the place stays remarkable good-natured, much thanks to the friendly staff. Music controlled by customers, with some basic rules such as songs usually need to be in English if there are words (apparently to dissuade K-Pop and Vietnamese ballads from going on). Have your typical domestic beers, and a few bottled craft beers and one or two craft beers on tap from Rooster. Soju and typical liquors and mixers also available. Though John and his staff will try to make you whatever you order, usually they are limited to basic booze-n-mixer drinks (you won't get a frozen margarita or mojito here). The food is solid though the wings are breaded, which some people think is an abomination. They're tasty. Lemon Pepper is great. Philly Cheese Steak sandwich is the best in town. Just a note, you will leave smelling of tobacco smoke and chicken fryer grease if you spend more than an hour here. Part of the dive bar charm.

Great food and service
Oct 2015 • Friends
Wings has its own individual character. It's unique to Saigon in a few ways. The proprietor makes every effort to ensure the quality of his product and is always aiming to please clientele. It kind of reminds me of the bar called 
"Cheers". Sometimes you want to get away and be at a place where everyone knows your name. I don't generally think of things in terms of a how much much, rather consider things as how good. I can have a nibble on something which will blow my taste buds for six or shovel down an plateful of moderate. I would often prefer quality over quantity. To state it clearly, it's a small bar but given solid clientele and a quality menu of delicious chicken treats, Wings proves time and time again to be a popular spot for travelers and veteran expats.

A GREAT 'GO TO' SPOT
Dec 2013 • Friends
I was invited to Wings to watch a sporting event by friends of mine who are established restaurant owners here in Ho Chi Minh City. Having lived here for nearly five years, I'm always interested in trying something new. I was very impressed with both the food, and the service. The off-menu breakfast sandwiches were unbelievable and every menu item that I tasted that day have kept me coming back on a routine basis. 
As someone who enjoys cooking at home, as well as dining out, I have my list of 'go to' spots. Places that I go to when I have a specific craving. Wings is definitely on my top 3. 
Aside from the fantastic menu items, the atmosphere is relaxed and the service far surpasses what one would experience at most, if not all, of the other restaurants in the area. 
If you're a tourist looking for a taste from home or, a local looking for a more relaxed place to eat and have a few beers, Wings is the spot! You won't be disappointed....
